summary: 编写和维护游戏设计文档：一页式 GDD、功能索引和简短功能说明，用链接与状态检查让文档和代码保持一致。 Writes and maintains a game's design docs: a one-page GDD with a feature index and short feature notes, kept true to the code by a link and status checker. Use for "draft a GDD", "spec out this mechanic", or updating docs after a playtest or code change. Not for building a game when no docs were asked for (`prototype-fast`, `game-jam`), READMEs or level layouts (`level-design`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill game-docs，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for "draft a GDD", "spec out this mechanic", or updating docs after a playtest or code change.
Workflow: Look before writing; Pick the mode; Write; Verify.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：prototype-fast 用 gene_gdsk_prototype_fast_v1，game-jam 用 gene_gdsk_game_jam_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
